reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "HelmRepository v1 schema: 1 field now required: `status.artifact.digest`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: HelmRepository objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check HelmRepository objects (source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1) for status.artifact.digest and ensure the field is populated so objects are not rejected by the new schema.

proposed.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of HelmRepository now requires the field status.artifact.digest, and objects that omit it are rejected.
